framing.lineOfInquiry: Rajesh Gill (P00226) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE004
framing.alternate: Rajesh Gill (P00226) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Rajesh Gill was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Recorded at Sarabha Nagar Residential, Ludhiana, 80.9 km from the scene, 23 min after the incident — could not have reached the scene by road in that time

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Rajesh Gill was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Rajesh Gill's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
